nodes.label: Activity Line (twisted into the circle)
nodes.rationale: GitHub-contributor-style line bent into a ring at journey end; only appears after unlock, otherwise it would be a banned streak mechanic.

nodes.label: Announcement Feed (three events)
nodes.rationale: News not content: journey launched, reflection left, path crossed. No images, so nothing consumed passively.

nodes.label: Brand Language: Yoga and Vibration
nodes.rationale: Borrow vocabulary from yoga rather than tech; 432 Hz as brand poetry only, not a health claim.

nodes.label: Build Decisions 2026-10-25 (Phase 1)
nodes.rationale: Settled for data model and fixtures; mirrors Functional-Spec.md §20 and applied in Phase-1-Proposal.md. Supersedes several earlier decisions (start-of-year commit, per-photo reflection windows, close friends see everything, two-sided crossing, private default, yearly name change).

nodes.label: Capturing the Low Points
nodes.rationale: Invitation, never a nudge; a promise to yourself, proven a year later. Still open whether to encourage actively.

nodes.label: Chapter Tags (fixed categories)
nodes.rationale: Where you are; fixed so feeds stay findable; one per journey; organised under journey relationships.

nodes.label: Circling Back
nodes.rationale: The circle is the product's shape: anniversaries return, journeys repeat, layers are concentric rings.

nodes.label: Commit Button
nodes.rationale: Commit carries weight Start/Create do not; choosing your own constraint is the first act of intention. Cannot be changed; journey runs 12 months from commit date.

nodes.label: Contemplator (hard, 12/yr, 1 highlight)
nodes.rationale: For deliberate disconnectors wanting photos purely as commemoration.

nodes.label: Explorer (easy, 48/yr, 4 highlights)
nodes.rationale: For people used to instant photography, including teenagers.

nodes.label: Feeling Tags (free)
nodes.rationale: How you are: hang in there, it eventually pays off, thankful, worried for nothing; free text, popular tags promoted over time.

nodes.label: Go-to-Market Hypothesis (Valentine's Day secret Journeys)
nodes.rationale: 1,000 disconnectors building secret journeys; revised to long-term vision since it gives no learning for 12 months. Short-loop first test still open.

nodes.label: Handwritten A4 Note
nodes.rationale: Then-you's voice in own hand, photographed as the writing on the back. Optional skippable step up to 15 minutes after capture. Shift from handwriting to typed text is the passage of time.

nodes.label: Highlights
nodes.rationale: Limited 24h window where frame limit does not apply; capped at type's yearly quota; one open at a time. Open concern: cuts against scarcity.

nodes.label: Identity and User Names (names from within)
nodes.norm_label: identity and user names (names from within)
nodes.rationale: We are all passengers; nothing on a profile signals looks or status. Avoid Native American naming appropriation. One name chosen once and kept (2026-10-25).

nodes.label: Intentional Disconnector
nodes.rationale: Placeholder name; alternatives The Returners, The Quiet Ones, Slow Keepers.

nodes.label: Journey Overview (Year Note)
nodes.rationale: Summary of how views changed over the year; one per journey per year, sealed, stacking, optional, readable by network.

nodes.label: Journey Relationships (ME→ME, ME→YOU, ME→IT, OTHERS→ME)
nodes.rationale: ME→YOU can be collected in secret.

nodes.label: Three Journey Types
nodes.rationale: Replace the 24–48 range with difficulty levels (48/24/12), each halving the one above, to reach different audiences with the same ritual.

nodes.label: Layers (earned by crossing Journeys)
nodes.rationale: Concentric rings (Apple Watch menu), not followers; recalculated yearly; tight 5+, middle 2–4, outer 1; one-sided; drift one ring per journey with no crossing; never shown to the person on it; no face recognition.

nodes.label: Military Draft Founding Story
nodes.rationale: 'The hard part is just the first 2–3 days' — origin of the 'the hard part was the start' tag; must be in website and product DNA.

nodes.label: OTHERS → ME (hope from others)
nodes.rationale: Someone else got through it, so I can too; fourth relationship alongside ME→OLD ME.

nodes.label: Phasing (all segments together; printing phase 2)
nodes.rationale: Launch message must unite segments via the ritual; phase 1 has no revenue line.

nodes.label: Physical Album (1970s–90s family album)
nodes.rationale: Two photos per page, thick pages, plastic sheet, handwritten names; shows the real year. Phase 2.

nodes.label: The Positivity Feed
nodes.rationale: Filtered by endurance and gratitude tags, fed only by public journeys; the reason to open the app during a sealed year. Protected from hardship-performance because reflections are written years later.

nodes.label: Print-Shop Ritual
nodes.rationale: Deliberate hassle echoing film drop-off; but no shop in a city is a wall, needs a fallback.

nodes.label: Reflect (per-photo yearly reflection)
nodes.rationale: One per photo per year, sealed, no edits, no comments from others; stacks forever. Never pushed. All photos move to next slot together on unlock anniversary.

nodes.label: Reveal (annual unlock)
nodes.rationale: Where engagement lives: first reflection, chapter/feeling tags, people tags, visibility. Choices set once and lock when reveal is finished.

nodes.label: Revenue Model (print-shop subscription vs own printing)
nodes.norm_label: revenue model (print-shop subscription vs own printing)
nodes.rationale: Charge certified print shops monthly; reopened 2026-10-17 to consider owning printing or a hybrid due to chicken-and-egg shop economics.

nodes.label: Open Question: Smallest Launch Version
nodes.rationale: The only question still blocking anything; the thing to prove first is whether a group starts, keeps capturing, and still cares at reveal.

nodes.label: The Circle (identity mark, rings, record not rank)
nodes.norm_label: the circle (identity mark, rings, record not rank)
nodes.rationale: Each year adds a ring framing the profile picture, like tree rings: tells age, never ranks. No leaderboards, badges, tiers.

nodes.label: Unresolved Fork: Upload Model vs Sealed Model
nodes.norm_label: unresolved fork: upload model vs sealed model
nodes.rationale: Original voice note had upload-when-ready and feed of past years; concept doc removed both; current direction assumes sealed version.

nodes.label: User Profiles
nodes.rationale: Disconnector, Life Chapter Keeper, Parent, Partner, Family member, Founder, Artist, Community.

nodes.label: Visibility (Private / Network / Public, per photo)
nodes.rationale: Chosen at reveal because a year later you know how the year turned out. Network is default; public is readable, not commentable.

nodes.label: Walking Someone's Path
nodes.rationale: Track a Journey from beginning to now; a record, not advice. Discovering you were in someone's hardest year is a key payoff.

nodes.label: Business Model by Phase
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 app with no revenue; phase 2 albums with own-printing, partner shops, or both.

nodes.label: The Network (Feed / Layers / Profile)
nodes.rationale: Nothing consumed passively; open signup with invitation as main path.

nodes.label: Testing screens at several simulated times
nodes.norm_label: testing screens at several simulated times

nodes.label: Gate control procedure
nodes.rationale: A gate that passes on someone's say-so is a failed gate.

nodes.label: How the build runs (phases, gates, agents)
nodes.norm_label: how the build runs (phases, gates, agents)

nodes.label: Commit (choose journey type, 12-month journey)
nodes.rationale: Cannot be changed afterwards; one journey at a time; no abandoning.

nodes.label: The profile (circle, one ring per year)
nodes.norm_label: the profile (circle, one ring per year)

nodes.label: Reflect (one immutable reflection per photo per year)
nodes.norm_label: reflect (one immutable reflection per photo per year)

nodes.label: Reveal (whole journey unlocks after 12 months)
nodes.rationale: The single engagement moment of the year.

nodes.label: Voice: nostalgic 1970s-90s family album, six lines
nodes.norm_label: voice: nostalgic 1970s-90s family album, six lines

nodes.label: Content Manager agent
nodes.rationale: A reviewer of the copywriter's work, not a second writer.

nodes.label: QA and quality gate control agent
nodes.norm_label: qa and quality gate control agent

nodes.label: My Journey (project memory)
nodes.rationale: The product is not about photographs; it is about what happens when time becomes part of the product.

nodes.label: /phase skill (supervisor loop)
nodes.rationale: Workers report to the supervisor, never to each other; shared state is docs/.

nodes.label: Only the user passes a gate
nodes.norm_label: only the user passes a gate
nodes.rationale: The supervisor does not grade its own workers' output.

nodes.label: has_journey_underway(user)
nodes.rationale: Others may know only that a sealed journey exists (D17)

nodes.label: Sealed-year empty state
nodes.rationale: The hardest screen: must feel intentional, not broken, and leak nothing.

nodes.label: Append-only reflections and overviews at data layer
nodes.norm_label: append-only reflections and overviews at data layer

nodes.label: Handwritten A4 note (back of photo, 15-minute window)
nodes.norm_label: handwritten a4 note (back of photo, 15-minute window)

nodes.label: Sealed content is unreadable, not hidden
nodes.norm_label: sealed content is unreadable, not hidden

nodes.label: Rules Guardian agent (adversarial critic)
nodes.rationale: Finds what a competent builder added by reflex: every banned item is something a normal product would do.

nodes.label: Rings are a record, not a level
nodes.norm_label: rings are a record, not a level
nodes.rationale: Rings must never read as a progress bar.

nodes.label: Rules live in the database (grants, triggers, RLS, constraints)
nodes.norm_label: rules live in the database (grants, triggers, rls, constraints)
nodes.rationale: Append-only means no UPDATE/DELETE path exists; sealed means count(*) returns 0 even for the owner.

nodes.label: Report at least one finding (weakest point)
nodes.norm_label: report at least one finding (weakest point)

nodes.label: The banned list
nodes.rationale: Breaking one is a build failure, not a style disagreement.

nodes.label: Enforce rules in code, not by convention
nodes.norm_label: enforce rules in code, not by convention

nodes.label: No layer is ever shown to the person on it
nodes.norm_label: no layer is ever shown to the person on it

nodes.label: Low usage is the goal
nodes.rationale: If a change would increase time in app, it is probably wrong.

nodes.label: No ads anywhere
nodes.rationale: Ads need attention, which the product rejects.

nodes.label: No comments from anyone else
nodes.rationale: The only voice on a photo is the owner's.

nodes.label: No edits to reflections
nodes.rationale: You never rewrite your past self; you add a new one.

nodes.label: No streaks, counters, progress bars, reminders
nodes.norm_label: no streaks, counters, progress bars, reminders
nodes.rationale: Engagement mechanics and re-engagement notifications are banned outright.

nodes.label: No face recognition
nodes.rationale: People are tagged by hand, deliberately.

nodes.label: No ranking, levels, badges, leaderboards
nodes.rationale: The circle is a record, not a rank.

nodes.label: No retakes
nodes.rationale: The moment is gone; however imperfect, that is the photo.

nodes.label: Nothing leaks from a sealed year
nodes.norm_label: nothing leaks from a sealed year
nodes.rationale: Not thumbnails, not counts, not '3 moments captured'.

nodes.label: Art Director (role)
nodes.rationale: The circle system and the nostalgic register

nodes.label: Autonomy Ladder
nodes.rationale: Most of this build is a workflow, not an autonomous agent; multi-agent uses ~15x tokens

nodes.label: Budgets and Stopping Conditions in Code
nodes.norm_label: budgets and stopping conditions in code
nodes.rationale: Asking nicely is not a stopping condition; same logic as enforcing append-only at the data layer

nodes.label: Rules Guardian as Critic with Teeth
nodes.norm_label: rules guardian as critic with teeth
nodes.rationale: A critic with the same model and prompt agrees with itself; needs rubric, adversarial brief, at least one issue, deterministic checks, three-round cap

nodes.label: Every Finding Becomes a Permanent Check
nodes.norm_label: every finding becomes a permanent check
nodes.rationale: The rubric grows; it never shrinks

nodes.label: The Folder Is the Blackboard
nodes.rationale: Shared context at start plus explicit synthesis reconciles conflicting assumptions

nodes.label: Phase 6 — Review
nodes.rationale: Rules audit with zero findings matters most

nodes.label: QA (role)
nodes.rationale: QA and Quality Control are the same role

nodes.label: Rules Guardian (role)
nodes.rationale: The one role a normal project doesn't have; every banned item is something a competent designer would add by reflex

nodes.label: Supervisor and Workers Pattern
nodes.rationale: Workers report evidence, not conclusions, to the supervisor; never to each other

nodes.label: UX (role)
nodes.rationale: Flows, separate from art direction

nodes.label: Every Step Names a Verifiable Output
nodes.norm_label: every step names a verifiable output

nodes.label: What the System Must Never Do
nodes.norm_label: what the system must never do

nodes.label: The Banned List
nodes.rationale: Breaking one is a build failure, not a style disagreement

nodes.label: Rules Rubric Deliverable (Rules-Rubric.md)
nodes.rationale: Starts from Phase-1-Proposal §2.5's 11 data-layer checks; banned list's screen-level rules not yet written as checks

nodes.label: Deliberately Not in This Plan
nodes.rationale: No real auth/storage/printing, no mobile apps, no revenue mechanism

nodes.label: Phase 4 — Build the App
nodes.rationale: Screens in ritual order, each usable before the next starts

nodes.label: Album and Print (phase 2)
nodes.rationale: Print-shop ritual; the hassle is deliberate

nodes.label: Capture (three taps, no retakes)
nodes.rationale: Photo taken in-app at the moment; no retakes, no quality bar, photos only, sealed automatically

nodes.label: Commit
nodes.rationale: The word Commit is deliberate and carries the weight; locks the type for the year, no default pre-selected, no abandoning

nodes.label: Feed (announcements only)
nodes.rationale: No photographs; fires on journey launched, reflection left, path crossed; navigating to a journey must take a small deliberate act

nodes.label: Frame Carry-Forward
nodes.rationale: Each journey month has its own limit; unused frames carry forward and lapse when the journey ends

nodes.label: Journey Types (Explorer / Wanderer / Contemplator)
nodes.rationale: Each step halves the one above; types sit on the old 24-48 range's ceiling, middle and floor

nodes.label: Layer (closeness ring)
nodes.rationale: Earned, not chosen: computed from crossing journeys; drift outward is a feature, nobody drops off the map

nodes.label: No Face Recognition (manual people tagging)
nodes.rationale: Tagging people by hand is deliberate manual work

nodes.label: Reveal
nodes.rationale: The single annual engagement moment; layers recalculated only here

nodes.label: The Sealed Year
nodes.rationale: Nothing visible to anyone including the owner; no previews, counts or thumbnails

nodes.label: announcement record
nodes.rationale: No media column, no count column; only three types

nodes.label: capture() function
nodes.rationale: Returns only accepted/refused; frames used/left never stored or returned (no counters)

nodes.label: journey_reveal record
nodes.rationale: Its existence is what locks the reveal

nodes.label: Layer Computation Algorithm
nodes.rationale: On reveal finish: count tags per user (5+ tight, 2-4 middle, 1 outer); untagged members drift out one ring; B's map never changes from A's tags

nodes.label: Rules Enforced in Postgres (grants, triggers, RLS, constraints)
nodes.norm_label: rules enforced in postgres (grants, triggers, rls, constraints)
nodes.rationale: Rules sit in the database so they hold even when app code is wrong

nodes.label: Row-Level Security Sealing
nodes.rationale: Rows readable only once app_now() >= unlocks_at, including by the owner, so count(*) returns 0

nodes.label: Stack Decision (open, blocks Phase 3)
nodes.rationale: Proposal says local Postgres but a Vercel project exists; deploying needs hosted Postgres and a web framework choice

nodes.label: Scripted future (actions applied on clock jumps)
nodes.norm_label: scripted future (actions applied on clock jumps)

nodes.label: app_now()
nodes.rationale: Every read of 'now' goes through it so time can be simulated.

nodes.label: Handwritten Note
nodes.rationale: Optional second step after capture so the moment is never held up; addable up to 15 minutes after capture (§20 B, K)

nodes.label: Highlight
nodes.rationale: Limited 24-hour user-started window where the frame limit does not apply; capped at the type's yearly quota

nodes.label: Reflection
nodes.rationale: Immutable, one per photo per year; you never rewrite your past self, you add a new one

nodes.label: User (core object)
nodes.rationale: Name comes from within, not physical attributes; nothing on a profile signals looks or how well someone is doing

nodes.label: Derived Journey State (sealed / revealing / revealed)
nodes.rationale: State derived from the clock, never stored; spec's separate committed state collapses into sealed

nodes.label: Readings R1–R5
nodes.rationale: R5 takes the stricter reading of D12: reveal choices set once each, even before finish

nodes.label: Data Model and Fixture Design Done (approved 2026-10-25)
nodes.norm_label: data model and fixture design done (approved 2026-10-25)

nodes.label: Functional Spec
nodes.rationale: Build reference; every behaviour traces to a decision in My-Journey-Concept.md, nothing invented to fill a gap

nodes.label: Phase 1 Proposal: Data Model and Fixtures
nodes.norm_label: phase 1 proposal: data model and fixtures

nodes.label: Emotional composition (paths cross again after years)
nodes.norm_label: emotional composition (paths cross again after years)
nodes.rationale: The demo works because two paths cross again after years apart.

nodes.label: Fixtures and a time control come before any screen
nodes.norm_label: fixtures and a time control come before any screen
nodes.rationale: Nothing in the product is visible until a year has passed.

nodes.label: Rule zero: never invent a behaviour
nodes.norm_label: rule zero: never invent a behaviour
nodes.rationale: Almost every sensible default in this category is deliberately banned, so a plausible guess is worse than a blocked task.

nodes.label: Fixture Designer (role)
nodes.rationale: The demo lives or dies here

nodes.label: Fixtures and Time Control Before Any Screen
nodes.norm_label: fixtures and time control before any screen

nodes.label: Lead Tech (role)
nodes.rationale: Owns the data model and the time control

nodes.label: Phase 3 — Foundation
nodes.rationale: The whole project's pivot; fixtures and time control before any screen

nodes.label: Demo and Fixture Requirements
nodes.rationale: Nothing is visible until a year has passed, so the product cannot be demonstrated without fixtures

nodes.label: Feeling Tags
nodes.rationale: Free text; popular ones surface and best get promoted into official categories

nodes.label: Positivity Feed
nodes.rationale: Filtered by endurance and gratitude tags, never popularity; fed only by public journeys

nodes.label: Visibility Levels (Private / Network / Public)
nodes.rationale: Set per photo at publish, not capture; Network default; public means readable, not commentable

nodes.label: Crossing Paths Fixture
nodes.rationale: Lantern and Wind tight, drift to outer, then tight again after two years; plus asymmetry and typed-name tests

nodes.label: First Light (fixture user)
nodes.rationale: No journey; tests an empty network

nodes.label: Long Way Round (fixture user)
nodes.rationale: Founder, ME→IT; main Positivity Feed source; journey #4 unlocked but never revealed

nodes.label: photo_visibility record
nodes.rationale: No row means Network

nodes.label: Second Wind (fixture user)
nodes.rationale: The friend whose path crosses again

nodes.label: sim_clock (simulated clock)
nodes.rationale: One clock, forward-only controls (+1 day/month/year, +5 years, next unlock, reset)

nodes.label: Steady Lantern (fixture user)
nodes.rationale: Primary demo persona, ME→ME; 5 revealed journeys, 1 sealed

nodes.label: Founder Story (deactivated Instagram)
nodes.rationale: The medium was the problem, not the desire to capture or share.

nodes.label: My Journey (product)
nodes.rationale: Photos sealed at capture, unlocking one year later; the product is about what happens when time becomes part of the product. Not attention, intention.

nodes.label: Naming (My Journey, originally Retrogram)
nodes.rationale: Retrogram set aside; Journey fits normal speech; Journal, Chapter, Almanac, Keepsake, Unfold considered; trademark check needed.

nodes.label: Pitch Deck as Family-Album Experience
nodes.rationale: Interactive HTML album with page-turn; must state strict-at-capture, no retakes, low usage, 'this app takes time' early.

nodes.label: The Ritual (Capture→Seal→Wait→Reveal→Reflect→Preserve→Repeat)
nodes.rationale: Whole journey sealed and unlocks once a year as a single event (2026-10-25). Photos only, in-app, no quality bar.

nodes.label: The Path (timeline length, why start today)
nodes.norm_label: the path (timeline length, why start today)
nodes.rationale: Time can't be bought later; honest urgency; a copycat cannot give a user a path that begins in 2019.

nodes.label: Trust as a Memory Keeper
nodes.rationale: Hardest promise is longevity; independence, never selling the archive, export guarantees, and the physical album as final trust layer.

nodes.label: My Journey — Working Concept
nodes.rationale: Living decision record with dated decisions; sourced from Brainstorming docx files.

nodes.label: My Journey — Product Overview
nodes.rationale: Export of the live doc (21 Oct 2026); the concept doc remains the full working record. Predates the 2026-10-25 build decisions, so some statements are stale (layers require both to upload, close friends get everything, name could change yearly, reflection window per-photo anniversary).

nodes.label: Core Message: You've Come Further Than You Think
nodes.norm_label: core message: you've come further than you think
nodes.rationale: People do not see how far they have come; your own photo from a year ago is proof. Stronger than 'not attention, intention' because it is about the person.

nodes.label: Defensibility (copy the feature, not the intent)
nodes.norm_label: defensibility (copy the feature, not the intent)
nodes.rationale: Instagram can copy the feature but an attention-funded business cannot sell slowness. Candidate moats unproven; passes the remove-sharing stress test.

nodes.label: Delayed Gratification + Delayed Perspective
nodes.rationale: The reward is meeting who you were through the eyes of who you are now; delayed perspective is the stronger idea.

nodes.label: Design Test: Nobody Leaves Feeling Worse
nodes.norm_label: design test: nobody leaves feeling worse
nodes.rationale: Users should leave hopeful, motivated, optimistic. Honest limit: never promise everything turns out fine, only that people kept going.

nodes.label: Low Usage Is the Goal
nodes.rationale: Stated publicly; no competitor can say it. Standard engagement metrics would read the product as failure; low usage is correct behaviour, not a retention problem.

nodes.label: No Retakes Rule
nodes.rationale: The moment is gone; users pushed to capture the moment, not get it right.

nodes.label: Company Philosophy: Product Before Money
nodes.rationale: No engagement mechanics, no ads, no selling memories or data; revenue follows from being genuinely good.

nodes.label: Strict at Capture, Generous at Reflect
nodes.norm_label: strict at capture, generous at reflect
nodes.rationale: Capture is three taps with no tagging or writing; all engagement lives at reveal, giving one real engagement moment a year. Front-of-deck pitch material.

nodes.label: Three Jobs (hope, appreciation, stop overthinking)
nodes.rationale: Keep hope alive through hard times, let people appreciate what they achieved, stop overthinking and worrying.

nodes.label: Tone: Self-Recognition, Self-Progression, Self-Awareness
nodes.rationale: The axis it competes on vs Instagram's show-off instant. Nothing should ask the user to perform.

nodes.label: The Rules (product rules table)
nodes.rationale: Strict at capture, no retakes, no quality bar, sealed at capture, no edits, no comments, no face recognition, no ads, no engagement mechanics, low usage is the goal.

nodes.label: Activity Graph (after unlock only)
nodes.rationale: A visible grid being filled is a streak mechanic and is banned

nodes.label: Profile Circle and Rings
nodes.rationale: One ring per year; a record not a rank: no scores, levels, leaderboards, badges

nodes.label: Core Message: People Do Not See How Far They Have Come
nodes.norm_label: core message: people do not see how far they have come
nodes.rationale: You cannot argue with your own photo from a year ago

nodes.label: Low Usage Is the Goal
nodes.rationale: If a decision would increase time in app, it is probably the wrong decision

nodes.label: Never Invent a Behaviour
nodes.rationale: Almost every normal app behaviour is deliberately banned; a plausible guess is worse than a blocked task
